title: Payment status transitions from pending to completed
gherkin:
Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Payment transitions from pending to completed
    Given a payment is in pending status
    When the payment is processed successfully
    Then the payment status should be updated to completed
    And the status change should be recorded in the tracking history
rationale: Validates that payment status can transition from pending to completed state, which is a fundamental requirement for payment status tracking
generationSummary: Payment status tracking rule - Test suite for validating payment status transitions, tracking mechanisms, and status-related business logic

title: Payment status transitions from pending to failed
gherkin:
Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Payment transitions from pending to failed
    Given a payment is in pending status
    When the payment processing fails
    Then the payment status should be updated to failed
    And the failure reason should be recorded
rationale: Ensures payment status tracking captures failed payment attempts, which is critical for payment status management
generationSummary: Payment status tracking rule - Test suite for validating payment status transitions, tracking mechanisms, and status-related business logic

title: Payment status history is maintained
gherkin:
Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Payment status history is maintained
    Given a payment with multiple status changes
    When I retrieve the payment status history
    Then all previous status values should be recorded
    And each status change should have a timestamp
rationale: Validates that the system maintains a complete audit trail of payment status changes, essential for tracking and compliance
generationSummary: Payment status tracking rule - Test suite for validating payment status transitions, tracking mechanisms, and status-related business logic

title: Payment status is immediately updated upon completion
gherkin:
Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Payment status updates immediately
    Given a payment is being processed
    When the payment completes successfully
    Then the status should be updated immediately
    And no delay should occur in status reflection
rationale: Ensures real-time status tracking so users and systems have current payment information
generationSummary: Payment status tracking rule - Test suite for validating payment status transitions, tracking mechanisms, and status-related business logic

title: Payment status cannot transition to invalid states
gherkin:
Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Invalid status transitions are prevented
    Given a payment in completed status
    When an attempt is made to change it to pending
    Then the status change should be rejected
    And the payment should remain in completed status
rationale: Validates that the payment status tracking rule enforces valid state transitions and prevents invalid status changes
generationSummary: Payment status tracking rule - Test suite for validating payment status transitions, tracking mechanisms, and status-related business logic

    When an authorized user requests the payment details

title: Payment status tracking handles concurrent updates

Feature: Payment Status Tracking
  Scenario: Concurrent payment status updates are handled safely
    Given multiple concurrent payment processing requests
    When status updates occur simultaneously
    Then only one status update should be applied
    And the system should maintain data consistency
rationale: Validates that payment status tracking is thread-safe and handles concurrent operations without data corruption

    And the refund status should be tracked independently

title: Payment status tracking supports status filtering and queries
